libs.note: BH-5357. Whether a PR push that only merges its base branch reuses the previous head's green Harness CI run for the lint steps catalog/ci-merge-reuse.tsv maps (verification-map, derived docs, lane renders, render-diff). Resolved by mp_knob through lib_env_apply in a subshell, then from this file's own default. CI cannot read the settings row; it reads the repo Actions variable PR_CI_MERGE_REUSE, then this default.

knobs.note: on | off. on: a merge-from-main push whose previous head has a green run skips the mapped lint steps its change cannot reach. off: every step runs on every push, as before BH-5357. Anything else reads as off.
